scientific-computing/fkb.manifest:
name = "fkb"
version = "0.0.0"
license = "MIT"
[library]
source-dir = "playground-library"
include-dir = ["src/lib"]
[build]
link = []
auto-executables = false
auto-examples = false
auto-tests = false
[install]
library = true
[fortran]
implicit-typing = true
implicit-external = true
source-form = "default"

scope: The upstream CMake neural library source set is wrapped for FPM in REAL64/INT32 mode with single-image coarrays and OpenMP. The deterministic consumer writes and loads a tiny two-dense-layer ReLU network, checks four predictions against independently calculated weights and biases, and verifies saving and reloading the model. K (Approximation) describes the tested neural-network inference. Training, Keras conversion tools, dropout and batch normalization are not verified; no optimization classification is inferred from their presence.
